Finite signed Laplace measure representability is precisely characterized using gamma transforms and boundedness. 453 finite high-precision checks passed; limiting results have an analytic proof.

value.rationale: Gives a finite-distance quantitative refinement of a recently proven universal Gamma limit at fixed explosion time, with explicit T-dependent leading bias, next-order fractional/analytic exponent transition at alpha=1/2, closed conditional count law and boundary-transform regularity. The correction is useful for benchmarks and for understanding low-count boundary effects; it is not merely rebranding the leading Gamma limit.
